exercises.title: A STUDY IN SCARLET
pages: Young Stamford looked at me in surprise. «You are as thin as a lath and as brown as a nut,» he said. I had come back from Afghanistan wounded and sick, and I needed a cheap flat in London. «Who is the man who wants to share rooms with me?» I asked. «You must meet him first. His name is Sherlock Holmes. He is a little strange, I think.»

In a laboratory at the hospital a young man jumped up from the corner and shook my hand. «I am very glad to see you. I see you have been to Afghanistan.» «How do you know that?» I cried. Stamford laughed: «Nothing simpler. He is a madman, an unpractical dreamer — that is my opinion of him. But he knows things.» Holmes smiled at me: «A doctor, I see, and a soldier.»

We found rooms at 221B Baker Street — bright and cheerful, with two bedrooms. Holmes did not study medicine. He studied crime: his science was to notice small things — a scratch on a boot, a stain on a sleeve — and from them to build the whole story of a man and his day. «You know,» he said one morning, «it is simple logic. Eliminate the impossible, and what remains, however improbable, must be the truth.»

exercises.prompt: Why did Dr. Watson need a cheap flat?
options: He had returned from the war wounded and sick.
He lost all his money in a casino.
exercises.explain: Ватсон вернулся из Афганистана раненым и больным; ему нужно недорогое жильё.

exercises.prompt: How did Holmes know Watson had been to Afghanistan?
options: He observed him and drew a conclusion.
exercises.explain: Текст описывает метод Холмса: замечать детали и делать выводы. Конкретные шаги вывода об Афганистане в адаптации не даны.

exercises.prompt: Where did Holmes and Watson live?

options: Noticing small things and building the story.
exercises.explain: Холмс замечает мелочи: царапину на ботинке, пятно на рукаве, — и делает выводы.
В финальной реплике после исключения невозможного остаётся истина: must be the truth.

exercises.prompt: Переведите: Мы снимаем жильё вместе. Используйте share.
exercises.explain: Также верно: We share an apartment.

exercises.prompt: Скажите в Present Perfect: Ты бывал в Лондоне?
exercises.explain: Спрашиваем об опыте до настоящего момента. Можно добавить ever.

objective: Понять вывод героя и описать совместное жильё.
